newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA fuel oil bunkers dip as barges fall.
newsitem.headline: ARA fuel oil bunkers dip as barges fall.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers dipped on Monday afternoon as the barge market came off, but prices at other European ports were little changed in a quiet start to the week, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 cst traded at around $115 fob in the morning, but, by afternoon, had fallen to $113 fob as the barge market weakened. A shortage of blending product left 180 cst prices unchanged. Dealers said there was little business, with ARA volume totalling less than 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were little changed from Friday at around $120/$122 delivered.
Mediterranean bunker prices were also steady. Ports in southern France received a few enquiries, but elsewhere activity was very thin.
Further east, Fujairah bunkers ticked up $1 a tonne to $114/$115 and traders said the market looked firm for the whole of October.
In Durban, fuel oil bunkers were unchanged as supply difficulties persisted.
